column1: # Maxima Fiction Book Editor - bundled genre extension (contracts/resource-formats.md §3).
# Genre codes used by the original FictionBook Editor 2.7 lists (FBE/genres.txt,
# FBE/genres.rus.txt) that the FB2 2.1 schema (schema/FictionBookGenres.xsd) does not
# enumerate. They are widespread in real-world libraries, so the editor accepts them in
# validation and offers them in the genre picker with the source "bundled-extension".
# Format (identical to user *.genres.tsv files): UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' comments.
# 'category' is a key of genres/categories.tsv (or a new key); name_ru falls back to name_en.
# Note: geo_guides is listed by the contract as a legacy code but the bundled 2.1 schema
# enumerates it, so it is a standard genre; the line below is kept for completeness and is
# ignored by the loader (the standard list always wins and is never modified).
